nom: No7 Radiance+ Vitamin C Daily Brightening Moisturizer

avis.texte: Great moisturizer and love how this makes my face feel but the fragrance is overwhelmingly strong.

The product is good but I was hoping for more hydration. Also, the service at this store is awful you have to go on an adventure to find someone to help you. Was over charged and had to come all the way back.

avis.titre: I love this product. I will buy it again.
avis.texte: I just wish you had a face cleanser too every time I look for it it's always out
This is a thing that I searched for very light weight non sticky and effective

Put this moisturizer on and had to take it off within minutes bc the smell was giving me a headache. I dont Understand why skincare companies think they need to add such strong fragrance to their products. Will be returning this product.

I started using this about a month ago and I love it! So this will now be two of their skincare products I really like and does the job. And again, affordable! I use it in my morning routine and feels great! Goes on smooth and light weight. I would recommend!

I just bought this came home put it on and instantly got a headache from the strong perfume smell. It's like they dumped a whole bottle of floral old lady perfume in this moisturizer. I looked at the ingredients and it actually says perfume and that shouldn't be in a face moisturizer. Returning this immediately
I used it for the first time a month ago … my skin is glowing It looks firmer and I definitely will buy again
I dont know what it is about this product but even if it is the onky thing I wear that day it atill peels and clumps on my skin after it dries. Nit a fan.

The moisturizer itself works well. I like the feel of my skin while wearing it. I gave it a week but I can't wear it any more. The scent is so strong and just to much for a facial moisturizer. It smells like the sunflower perfume my Mom wore in the 90's. So to me, it just smells very dated and old. haha I gave it away.

I love this day cream!! My face is prone to hormonal breakouts, and since using this product my skin has definitely calmed down. I don't even wear foundation anymore (unless its an event or something), I just put this on, then put on some concealer and bronzer and I'm good to go for the day! I love this face cream and will definitely purchase again.
Very strong fragrance smell and I think my skin started getting irritated by the product. Finished the container but I won't be buying it again.

I'm a 51-year-old woman and I'm noticing as I age my skin is becoming drier and it's very hard to find a good moisturizer but No7 is always my go to products. This moisturizer is so hydrating and I can tell you it's better than Chanel's $385 moisturizer. I love love all of their products.
I love using any type of Vitamin C serum or cream on my face and this has been my favorite so far. It gives my face a beautiful smooth look and glow. Love it!
I love that this moisturizer is sap light weight but moisturizing, too. Super product, my new favoriteee

avis.titre: This is the first time I have used this particular product.
avis.texte: It absorbs so easily into the skin. It is well-named "Radiance".

This solved my dry winter skin! I'm typically oily but with a cold winter this is the perfect answer. Helps to even my skin tone and keep my skin from feeling tight. Sometimes I layer a richer cream overtop for extra moisture. Great smell too!
Made my skin drier, not brightening at all, slightly helping my acne but that's it.

This is possibly the best moisturizer I've ever bought. I have combo skin and struggle with dry skin everywhere but my T zone. This moisturizer goes on and sinks into the skin almost immediately. It doesn't feel oily.

I am not normally one to leave a review, but I had to for this one. I'm also not one to normally be bothered too much by a scent, but this has to be the strongest smelling product I've ever used. ￼I've actually gotten mild headaches from how strong it is. As a moisturizer (scent aside), it's fine but didn't do anything super noticeable for me. There is seriously no need to use perfume if you are using this moisturizer (it reminds me of Clinique Happy from the￼ 90s). Holy wow.
I have been using this product for months and have seen a difference. My face looks brighter.

This would be a great product if not for the extremely strong scent. Maybe I'm just sensitive to it but it makes me not want to even finish the jar. It does feel nice on the skin but I feel like the fragrance is breaking me out.

This product is perfect for daily use. I put some on after I wash my face and it has left me feeling so smooth and moisturized. It also hasn't caused any breakouts which is hard for me to find. I highly recommend it!!
This moisturizer works great for my sensitive skin. It makes my face feel clean fresh, hydrated and bright.
Loved how my face felt smooth, with no greasy or heavy feeling. Bought because an esthetician recommended using products with Vitamin C in it.
I use it every morning. I realized that after I started using this product my face looks healthier, the skin is more uniform and hydrated.
Nice price, good packaging, but the perfume smell is much too strong. Beware if you are sensitive to strong smells.
I use every morning. I don't use anything else on my face. I love it!!

avis.titre: I like the whole vitamin C line
avis.texte: I've been using their vitamin c exfoliating cleanser and applying serum along with the cream and it makes my face look super glowy and hydrated !! I wouldn't use it as a daily combo but definitely at least 3 times a week (:

avis.titre: Love, but theres a warning for make up wearers
avis.texte: This is perfect for days when I am not wearing makeup. It's light and makes my skin look dewey. It feels hydrating as well. However it will make your makeup pill :(
The No7 brand is nice. The retinol type can be strong. The other types are really good.

avis.titre: Doesn't moisturizer my skin at all
avis.texte: I was really disappointed in this and won't be purchasing it again because it doesn't moisturizer my skin whatsoever. It turns liquidy as soon as you start applying it, kind of like a gel, and dries quickly; unfortunately when it dries my skin feels tight and just as dry as if I'd put nothing on at all. I still use it because I don't want to the purchase to be a total waste but I layer another richer face cream over it. I don't notice any "brightening" effect either. The only pro is that is has a nice smell. *my skin is fairly dry, somewhat flaky on my forehead and somewhat greasy around the corners of my nose, no sensitivities

I really like this product & use it after cleansing with the Radiance exfoliating cleanser, usually in the PM. I use most of the No. 7 products, as they are cruelty-free, gentle, effective, & affordable.
Good for every day use, not super thick, orange fragrance is clean and refreshing

This product really does brightens and moisturize my skin. It is quickly absorbed by my skin, and I appreciate it does, and do not leave my skin feeling sticky or oily. It does smells amazing! I have all the collection, and I can not love it more!

avis.titre: Will not buy this product again!
avis.texte: Will not purchase again! Definitely does not brighten my skin at all in fact it makes it look dull!

I have used No 7 products for years & really appreciate their being cruelty-free, gentle, & effective. Also smells great! I use this product alternately with the No 7 retinol & No 7 moisturizers & like them all very much.

I really wanted to be blown away by this product; unfortunately, I was not. VERY lightweight gel absorbs quickly, but I don't feel any moisturizing properties. I have normal skin, slightly dry in the winter, so this product didn't work for me. Also, after using it daily for a month, I see no "brightening" effects.
MY skin is combo (oily & dry) and this moisturizer is perfect with balancing it out!
So good. Makes my skin look amazing. One of my best purchases ever.
Not heavy - very light & a little goes a long way. Brightens my complexion

This is a very lightweight moisturizer. The gel cream formula does instantly absorb into the skin as suggested in the product description. I don't agree though that the product is for every skin type. I would say it's best for an oily skin type. I have normal to dry skin (in the winter), and this just isn't going to cut it. The fragrance is also very strong, and I didn't see any brightening like the product description suggested. The product left my skin tight and slightly irritated. I think it's probably the fragrance mixed with the vitamin C and gel cream formula. It's not a terrible product, I think you just need to consider your skin type as well as any sensitivities you may have before buying the product. I thought my skin could handle it because I have used fragranced and vitamin C products before, but I was wrong.

I apply Radiance+ Vitamin C Daily Brightening Moisturizer in the morning after face washing then a few minutes afterward I apply Restore & Renew Face & Neck Multi Action Day Cream SPF 30. In the evening I apply Radiance+ Vitamin C Daily Brightening Moisturizer then a few minutes afterward I apply Restore & Renew Face & Neck Multi Action Night Cream.
